Acne and Rosacea Photos.description: A class containing images associated with acne and rosacea-like facial conditions.
common_features: Acne may involve pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, or deeper inflammatory lesions.
Rosacea may cause persistent facial redness, flushing, and acne-like breakouts.
general_care: Use gentle skin care and avoid unnecessary irritation.
Avoid picking or squeezing lesions.
Identify and avoid personal triggers when relevant.
seek_care: Uncertainty about whether the condition is acne, rosacea, or another disorder

Actinic Keratosis Basal Cell Carcinoma a.description: This dataset category combines actinic keratoses, basal cell carcinoma, and other potentially malignant lesions.
common_features: Actinic keratosis may appear as a rough or scaly area on sun-damaged skin.
Basal cell carcinoma can appear as a shiny or raised growth, scaly patch, or sore that does not heal.
general_care: Protect skin from excessive ultraviolet exposure.
Monitor persistent, changing, bleeding, or non-healing lesions.
Avoid attempting to remove suspicious lesions yourself.
seek_care: A lesion that repeatedly bleeds or crusts
A sore that does not heal
A suspicious or persistent rough/scaly lesion

Atopic Dermatitis Photos.description: Atopic dermatitis is a type of eczema commonly associated with itchy, dry and inflamed skin.
common_features: Itching
Dry or scaly skin
Inflamed rash
Scratch marks
Sometimes oozing or crusting
general_care: Use gentle skin care.
Avoid known irritants or personal triggers.
Keep the skin adequately moisturized.
seek_care: Painful, oozing, crusted, or infected-looking areas

Cellulitis Impetigo and other Bacterial.description: A dataset category containing images of cellulitis, impetigo and other bacterial skin infections.
common_features: Redness or inflammation
Swelling
Tenderness or pain
Impetigo may produce pustules or crusted lesions
general_care: Keep affected areas clean.
Avoid sharing towels or personal items when an infectious condition is suspected.
Seek professional evaluation rather than relying on an image classification.

Eczema Photos.description: Eczema refers to a group of conditions that can cause itchy, dry, inflamed skin.
common_features: Itching
Dryness
Scaling
Inflammation
Cracking or irritation
general_care: Use gentle skin care.
Avoid known irritants.
Maintain skin hydration.
seek_care: Symptoms that interfere with daily activities

Exanthems and Drug Eruptions.description: This category contains generalized rashes and eruptions that may be associated with infections or medication reactions.
common_features: Widespread rash
Red or discolored patches
Possible itching
Distribution may vary depending on the cause
general_care: Review recent medication or exposure history with a healthcare professional.
Avoid assuming the cause from an image alone.

Herpes HPV and other STDs Photos.description: A dataset category containing images associated with herpes, HPV and other sexually transmitted infections.
common_features: Lesions may vary substantially depending on the infection.
Some viral infections may cause blisters, ulcers, papules, or warty growths.
general_care: Avoid sexual contact with active or unexplained lesions until professionally evaluated.
Do not share personal items that may contact lesions.
seek_care: Concern about possible sexually transmitted infection

Light Diseases and Disorders of Pigmenta.description: A broad dataset category containing disorders involving altered skin pigmentation.
common_features: Areas of lighter or darker pigmentation
Changes may be localized or more widespread
Appearance varies considerably between conditions
general_care: Protect affected skin from excessive ultraviolet exposure.
Avoid irritating products when the skin is sensitive.
Monitor new or changing pigmented areas.

Lupus and other Connective Tissue diseas.description: Lupus is a chronic autoimmune disease that can affect the skin and multiple organ systems.
common_features: Some forms can cause facial or other skin rashes.
Sun sensitivity may occur.
Other systemic symptoms can occur depending on the condition.
general_care: Protect skin from excessive sun exposure.
Seek professional evaluation for persistent or unexplained rashes.
Do not interpret an image classification as confirmation of lupus.
seek_care: Joint swelling or pain with skin symptoms

Melanoma Skin Cancer Nevi and Moles.description: This dataset category contains images associated with melanoma, nevi and moles.
common_features: A new or changing pigmented spot can be concerning.
Possible warning signs include asymmetry, irregular borders, varied color, increasing size, or change over time.
general_care: Perform regular skin checks.
Protect skin from excessive ultraviolet exposure.
Monitor changing lesions.
seek_care: A lesion that looks different from surrounding moles

Poison Ivy Photos and other Contact Derm.description: Contact dermatitis occurs when the skin reacts to an irritant or allergen.
common_features: Itching
Red or discolored rash
Burning or stinging
Swelling
Blisters or oozing may occur
general_care: Identify and avoid the suspected trigger.
Use gentle skin care.
Avoid further exposure to known irritants.

Psoriasis pictures Lichen Planus and rel.display_name: Psoriasis / Lichen Planus and Related Disorders
Psoriasis pictures Lichen Planus and rel.description: A dataset category containing psoriasis, lichen planus and related inflammatory disorders.
common_features: Psoriasis commonly produces raised, scaly plaques.
Appearance and distribution vary by subtype.
Lichen planus can produce different types of inflammatory lesions.
general_care: Use gentle skin care.
Identify personal triggers where applicable.
Seek professional evaluation for persistent lesions.
seek_care: Painful or rapidly worsening skin changes

Seborrheic Keratoses and other Benign Tu.description: Seborrheic keratoses are common non-cancerous skin growths that can resemble warts or other lesions.
common_features: Tan, brown, or darker growths
May have a warty or rough surface
Often appear as multiple growths
general_care: Avoid attempting to remove growths yourself.
Monitor for changes.
seek_care: A growth that looks substantially different from typical lesions

Systemic Disease.description: A broad dataset category containing skin findings associated with systemic diseases.
common_features: Skin findings vary substantially depending on the underlying systemic condition.
Image appearance alone may not identify the underlying disease.
general_care: Consider the complete clinical history rather than relying on an image.
Seek professional evaluation for persistent unexplained skin changes.
seek_care: Skin findings accompanied by systemic symptoms

Tinea Ringworm Candidiasis and other Fun.description: This category contains fungal infections including ringworm and candidiasis.
common_features: Ringworm commonly causes itchy, scaly, ring-shaped rashes.
Appearance varies depending on the body site and fungal infection.
general_care: Keep affected areas clean and dry.
Avoid sharing towels and other personal items.
Seek appropriate professional guidance for suspected fungal infection.
seek_care: Uncertainty about whether a rash is fungal

Urticaria Hives.description: Urticaria produces raised, itchy areas of skin that can appear and change over time.
common_features: Raised welts
Itching
Lesions may appear and disappear or move to different areas
general_care: Consider recent exposures or possible triggers.
Avoid known personal triggers when identified.
seek_care: Swelling involving the lips, tongue, or throat

Vascular Tumors.description: This dataset category contains vascular tumors and related vascular lesions.
common_features: Lesions may appear red, purple, blue, or otherwise vascular in appearance.
Appearance varies substantially between vascular lesions.
general_care: Avoid trauma to lesions that bleed easily.
Seek professional evaluation for new or changing vascular lesions.

Vasculitis Photos.description: Vasculitis refers to inflammation of blood vessels and can have skin manifestations.
common_features: Skin findings vary depending on the type and severity.
Some forms may produce purplish or non-blanching spots.
general_care: Unexplained purpuric or rapidly changing skin findings warrant professional evaluation.
Do not rely on image classification to determine the underlying cause.
seek_care: Abdominal, joint, kidney, or neurological symptoms

Warts Molluscum and other Viral Infectio.description: This dataset category contains warts, molluscum and other viral skin infections.
common_features: Warts may produce rough or raised growths.
Molluscum commonly produces small raised lesions.
Appearance varies by viral infection.
general_care: Avoid picking or scratching lesions.
Avoid sharing personal items that contact affected skin.
Seek professional guidance when lesions are persistent or uncertain.
